pages.title: Shapeless recipe
pages.label: Combine → one result
pages.text: Any chestplate + one slimeball. The iron chestplate shown is an example; all supported chestplates retain their material and data.

Equip Slime Armor on a Combat, Dragon, Saddle, or Royal Guard Slime. Normal chestplates are ingredients, not direct equipment. Conversion retains armor attributes, durability, enchantments, names, and leather color. Helmets, leggings, and boots do not qualify.
